editor.title: Editor
editor.hint: Press {{shortcut}} or choose “Capture region” in the tray.

images.label: Background image
images.deleteConfirm: Delete this image? Presets that use it will show a plain background.

export.scaleFixed: Platform sizes always export at 1x ({{width}} × {{height}} px)
export.dragHold: Hold the mouse button down while you drag the image out
export.dragHint: Drag the image into another app, a folder or a chat

presets.title: Presets
presets.empty: Save the current background to reuse it on other captures.
presets.name: Preset name
presets.imageMissing: This preset uses an image that is not on this computer. It may have been deleted, or the preset was made on another computer. A plain background is shown instead; pick an image to replace it.
presets.exportedWithImage: Exported {{fileName}}. This preset uses one of your own images, which is not inside the file; on another computer it shows a plain background.

history.title: History

confirm.message: Delete every capture in history? This can't be undone.

history.savingOff: Saving captures to history is off. You can turn it on in Settings.

shortcut.label: Capture shortcut
shortcut.description: Click the box, then press the new key combination.
shortcut.printScreenHint: Cropa opens a Windows setting so you can stop Windows from using PrtScn for its own screen capture.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: System follows the light or dark mode set in Windows.

autostart.label: Start Cropa when I sign in

history.label: Save captures to history
history.description: Cropa keeps your last 50 captures for 30 days in your user folder, as unencrypted PNG files.

clipboardPrivacy.label: Keep captures out of clipboard history
clipboardPrivacy.description: Cropa's captures won't appear in Windows clipboard history (Win+V) or sync to your other devices.

saveFolder.label: Save folder
saveFolder.notSet: Not set. Cropa asks the first time you save with Ctrl+S.

ShortcutInvalid.what: That key combination can't be used.
ShortcutInvalid.why: A global shortcut needs at least one modifier (Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win) and one main key.

ShortcutInUse.next: Pick a different combination below, or close the other app and restart Cropa.

PrintScreenInUse.what: PrtScn isn't working as the capture key.
PrintScreenInUse.why: Windows uses PrtScn to open its own screen snipping, or another screenshot app has taken the key.
PrintScreenInUse.next: In the Windows Keyboard settings, turn off the switch that uses the Print Screen key to open screen snipping, then come back to Cropa: it tries again on its own. Close any other screenshot app that uses PrtScn.

OpenSystemSetting.why: Windows didn't open the Settings app ({{detail}}).
OpenSystemSetting.next: Open Settings › Ease of Access › Keyboard yourself (Accessibility › Keyboard on Windows 11) and turn off the Print Screen switch.

SaveSettings.why: Cropa couldn't write its settings file ({{detail}}).
SaveSettings.next: Check that your user folder isn't full or read-only, then try again.

Autostart.next: Try again, or turn it on in Windows Settings › Apps › Startup.

HistoryMissing.what: That capture is no longer in history.
HistoryMissing.why: It was deleted, or it is older than 30 days.
HistoryMissing.next: Pick another capture from the list.

HistoryRead.why: Cropa couldn't read it from the history folder ({{detail}}).
HistoryRead.next: Try again, or delete it from history if the file is damaged.

HistoryDelete.next: Close any app that has the file open and try again.

Clipboard.why: Another app may be holding the clipboard ({{detail}}).
Clipboard.next: Close that app or try again.

Drag.why: Cropa couldn't hand the image to Windows ({{detail}}).
Drag.next: Try again, or use Copy or Save instead.

ExportInvalid.why: The picture Cropa prepared isn't a valid image in the chosen format.
ExportInvalid.next: Try again. If it keeps happening, restart Cropa.

ExportTooLarge.what: The image is too large to save.
ExportTooLarge.why: Cropa saves images up to {{detail}} MB.
ExportTooLarge.next: Make the image smaller, or choose a lighter format such as JPEG or WebP.

SaveFile.why: Windows refused to write the file ({{detail}}).
SaveFile.next: Check that the folder exists and isn't full or read-only, or choose another folder.

SaveAsExpired.why: The save location you chose is no longer valid, because another save started or Cropa lost track of it.

SaveDialog.next: Try again. If it keeps happening, restart Cropa.

SavedFileGone.why: The file was moved, renamed or deleted after Cropa saved it.

OpenFolder.next: Open the folder yourself in File Explorer.

OpenWebPage.next: Open github.com/sponsors/phuscth in your browser yourself.

EditorImage.what: Couldn't open the capture in the editor.
EditorImage.why: The image could not be decoded ({{detail}}).
EditorImage.next: Capture again, or open another capture from History.

OutputTooLarge.why: The image would be larger than 16384 pixels on one side.
OutputTooLarge.next: Reduce the padding or choose another aspect ratio.

UserPresetName.why: A preset name must have 1 to 40 characters and no control characters such as line breaks or tabs.
UserPresetName.next: Type a shorter or simpler name and try again.

UserPresetInvalid.next: Change the background and try again.

UserPresetTooLarge.why: This background has too many details to store as a preset.
UserPresetTooLarge.next: Remove some layers or points and try again.

UserPresetsFull.why: You already have the most presets Cropa can keep (200).
UserPresetsFull.next: Delete a preset you no longer use and try again.

UserPresetMissing.what: That preset is no longer there.
UserPresetMissing.why: It was deleted, possibly from another window.
UserPresetMissing.next: Save the background as a new preset instead.

UserPresetsTooNew.why: Your presets file was written by a newer version of Cropa, so this version leaves it untouched.
UserPresetsTooNew.next: Update Cropa to the latest version.

UserPresetsRead.why: Cropa couldn't read the presets file ({{detail}}).
UserPresetsRead.next: Check that your user folder isn't locked, then reopen the editor.

UserPresetsSave.why: Cropa couldn't write the presets file ({{detail}}).
UserPresetsSave.next: Check that your user folder has free space and isn't locked, then try again.

Unexpected.next: Try again. If it keeps happening, restart Cropa.

ExportRender.why: The image could not be drawn or encoded ({{detail}}).
ExportRender.next: Try a smaller scale or padding, or close other apps to free memory, then try again.

ExportFormatUnsupported.why: This version of WebView2 can't encode {{format}}.
ExportFormatUnsupported.next: Choose PNG or JPEG, or update Microsoft Edge WebView2.

PresetFileTooLarge.why: The file is larger than {{limit}} KB, so it isn't a Cropa preset.
PresetFileTooLarge.next: Choose a preset file exported from Cropa.

PresetFileNotJson.next: Choose a preset file exported from Cropa.

PresetFileInvalid.why: The file doesn't match the preset format ({{detail}}).
PresetFileInvalid.next: Check the file, or export the preset again from Cropa.

PresetFileTooNew.why: The file was made by a newer version of Cropa.
PresetFileTooNew.next: Update Cropa, then import it again.

ExportImageChanged.why: A new capture replaced the image in the editor while the Save dialog was open.
ExportImageChanged.next: Save the new image, or open the earlier one from History and save it again.

BackgroundImageNotSupported.why: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP pictures can be used as a background.
BackgroundImageNotSupported.next: Pick a PNG, JPEG or WebP file.

BackgroundImageTooLarge.why: The file is larger than {{detail}} MB.
BackgroundImageTooLarge.next: Pick a smaller file, or save a smaller copy of the picture first.

BackgroundImagesFull.why: You already have the most images Cropa can keep (100).
BackgroundImagesFull.next: Delete an image you no longer use and try again.

BackgroundImageMissing.what: That image is no longer there.
BackgroundImageMissing.why: Its file was deleted, possibly from another window or by another app.

BackgroundImagesTooNew.why: Your images were saved by a newer version of Cropa, so this version leaves them untouched.
BackgroundImagesTooNew.next: Update Cropa to the latest version.

BackgroundImagesRead.why: Cropa couldn't read its images folder ({{detail}}).
BackgroundImagesRead.next: Check that your user folder isn't locked, then reopen the editor.

BackgroundImagesSave.why: Cropa couldn't write to its images folder ({{detail}}).
BackgroundImagesSave.next: Check that your user folder has free space and isn't locked, then try again.

BackgroundImageDimensions.why: The picture is wider or taller than {{limit}} pixels.
BackgroundImageDimensions.next: Pick a smaller picture, or resize it first.

BackgroundImageUnreadable.why: The file couldn't be read as a picture. It may be damaged.

BackgroundImageLoad.why: The image couldn't be loaded. A user image may have been deleted.

AiProviderUnavailable.why: The test provider only exists in development builds.
AiProviderUnavailable.next: Pick Codex or Claude Code instead.

AiCliNotFound.what: Couldn't find the command line tool.
AiCliNotFound.why: It isn't on your PATH, so Cropa can't open its login.
AiCliNotFound.next: Install it with the install guide, then check again.

OpenTerminal.next: Open a terminal yourself and run the CLI’s login command, then check again.

status.unavailable: Not available in this version yet

onboarding.title: Set up AI
onboarding.intro: Cropa can use the Codex or Claude Code you already installed to name palettes and help with your images. Pick one that is ready, or set one up first. You can skip this and do it later in Settings.
onboarding.checking: Looking for Codex and Claude Code…

settings.title: AI
settings.allowImagesHint: Off by default. Even when on, Cropa asks before each screenshot leaves this computer.
settings.privacy: Cropa runs the Codex or Claude Code you installed, and what it does counts against your account there. Cropa never reads or stores your login. Screenshots are sent only when you allow it here and confirm each time.

imageConfirm.title: Send {{count}} image(s) to {{vendor}}?
imageConfirm.body: The screenshot will leave this computer and go to {{vendor}} through the {{provider}} you installed. It counts against your account there.
imageConfirm.offBody: To let Cropa send screenshots to AI, turn on "Allow sending images to AI" in Settings, under AI.

NotInstalled.why: Cropa runs {{provider}} on your computer and couldn't find it.
NotInstalled.next: Install it from Settings → AI, then check again.

NotLoggedIn.why: It needs your account before it can answer.
NotLoggedIn.next: In Settings → AI, choose "Log in in a terminal", finish the login, then try again.

UsageLimit.why: Your account has reached its usage limit for now.
UsageLimit.next: Wait until the limit resets, or check your plan with the provider.

Unsupported.why: This version of Cropa has no working connection to it for this task.
Unsupported.next: Pick another provider in Settings → AI, or update Cropa.

Timeout.why: It may be busy or offline.
Timeout.next: Check your internet connection and try again.

Protocol.why: The reply wasn't in a form Cropa understands. The CLI may have changed or be out of date.

Cancelled.next: Run it again when you are ready.

InvalidOutput.why: It didn't match the expected format, even after a second try.
InvalidOutput.next: Try again. If it keeps happening, update {{provider}}.

Locked.why: This task needs a feature that {{provider}} does not offer.
Locked.next: Pick another provider in Settings → AI.
